sources.notes: Default workflow, Jira truth, automatic bounded G2/G3 policy, validation.
Current state engine stops at completed after validation and does not model explicit G4/G5 states.
Enforces plan handoff, exact base/repository binding and plan-read receipt.
Required workflow named validate-instructions in project profile.

limitations: No materialized Git checkout; git status and untracked files cannot be verified.
No canonical UA base graph exists in the protected-base inventory.
Source inventory is bounded to verified architecture, governance, runtime-catalog and test surfaces.
The package is planning evidence, not repository execution evidence.
